 Date : 10-02-2025 This petition was called on for hearing today.
 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Mehta
 [In Chamber]
 For Petitioner(s) :Mr. Naresh Kumar, Aor
 Mr. Jaimon Andrews, Adv.
 Mr. Piyo Harold Jaimon, Adv.
 Mr. Firdouse C P, Adv.
 Mr. Shivam Sharma, Adv.
 For Respondent(s) :
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R The Trial Court convicted the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 306 and 498A of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
The first appellate Court set aside the conviction of the petitioner so far as the charge under Section 306 IPC is concerned.

The High Court, in criminal revision petition No.969 of 2014, reduced the sentence awarded to the petitioner on the count of Section 498A IPC from two years rigorous imprisonment to one year rigorous imprisonment.

17:49:27 IST Reason:
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn the attention of the Court to the suicide note written by the deceased- Smt. Vanaja as reproduced in the trail Courts judgment and urges that there is not a whisper in the suicide note regarding any act of cruelty by the petitioner against the deceased.
He thus urges that the petitioner deserves indulgence exemption from surrender.
